lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: I just got paid. Do I leave all of it in checking?

lines.speaker: gio
lines.text: I keep the money I’m about to spend in checking. Think rent, groceries, and gas.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Okay, but what if my car breaks down?

lines.speaker: gio
lines.text: That’s what my emergency money is for. I’d keep it in high-yield savings so it can earn interest while it’s set aside.
